look_here_first: Inspect stem hairs with a hand lens: numerous straight, forward-pointing, closely appressed NONSEPTATE hairs distinguish this from the spreading, partly septate hairs of O. stricta. Then check upright/ascending stems, usually 1–3 flowers per stalk, and mature capsules (often 12–20 mm).

project_inclusion.range_basis: Accepted FNA/POWO concept, recorded in Texas; project three-target-county native threshold not independently verified. Source-pool approval does not certify county nativity.

morphology_keys.habit: Annual or short-lived herb, stems erect to ascending; rooting pattern and stature variable.
morphology_keys.leaves: Palmately trifoliolate, each leaflet obcordate with a shallow to pronounced apical notch; petiole bases and stipule shape worth checking.
morphology_keys.stems: Stem hairs usually dense, straight, forward-directed and closely appressed; hairs nonseptate (contrast O. stricta).
morphology_keys.flowers: Yellow, 5-petaled; often 1–3 flowers per inflorescence; petals commonly 4–8 mm, but overlap requires multiple characters.
morphology_keys.fruit: Slender capsule commonly 12–20 mm, sometimes to 25 mm; inspect fully mature fruit and seed ridges.

comparisons.key_distinctions: O. stricta often has spreading septate hairs especially near nodes, usually more flowers (often 5–7), and shorter 8–15 mm capsules; O. albicans has short curved/crisped nonseptate hairs rather than the straight closely appressed hairs of O. dillenii. O. corniculata often roots at creeping nodes and shows conspicuous broad free stipule flanges.
comparisons.cautions: Hair septation needs macro/microscope, and flower number and fruit length overlap. Do not identify from yellow petals alone; confirm mature fruit, stipules, and multiple stem nodes.

diagnostic_image_needs: Whole plant showing ascending stems and rooting nodes
Close macro of forward-appressed NONSEPTATE stem hairs with scale
Leaf petiole base/stipule macro contrasted with O. corniculata
Mature capsule length and seed ridges with scale
Matched O. stricta node hair close-up
